ORANGE RAINFALL WARNING UP IN METRO MANILA, CALABARZON AND PARTS OF CENTRAL LUZON

PAGASA raised an Orange Rainfall Warning over Metro Manila, Bataan, Rizal, Cavite, Laguna, Batangas, parts of Zambales and Quezon early Thursday due to intense rains from the enhanced southwest monsoon.

The warning means flooding remains threatening, especially in low-lying and flood-prone areas.

A Yellow Warning is in effect in Pampanga, Tarlac, Bulacan, and other parts of Zambales and Quezon, where flooding is still possible if rains persist.

Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains are also affecting Nueva Ecija and may continue in the next three hours.

data.text:
STORM SIGNALS RAISED AS EMONG INTENSIFIES OFF WEST PH SEA

Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal No. 3 is up over parts of La Union and northern Pangasinan as Severe Tropical Storm #EmongPH brings winds of up to 110 km/h while moving southwestward over the West Philippine Sea.

Signal No. 2 is in effect over much of the Ilocos Region, Cordillera, central Pangasinan, and parts of Nueva Vizcaya. Signal No. 1 covers areas in Cagayan Valley, Zambales, Tarlac, Nueva Ecija, and nearby provinces.

PAGASA warns of strong winds and coastal flooding, while the enhanced southwest monsoon continues to bring heavy rains over Luzon, including Metro Manila, and Visayas.
